Subject: Annual prepay invoicing — phased billing plan?

Hi Rohan,

We're closing our budget for FY28 and want to finalize the invoicing pattern for the committed prepay (annual). Procurement has asked for a staggered invoicing approach so cash flow stays predictable on our side.

High level asks:
- Can you provide an example invoice schedule that covers: initial deposit, monthly drawdowns, and a final reconciliation invoice?
- We need VAT IDs and per-country VAT treatment lines on each invoice (we operate in US + UK/EU).
- Procurement requires PO documentation and an e-invoice with line-level tax.

Can you loop in finance/ops? If you can attach a sample schedule that would be great.

Thanks,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Finance, BluePeak Analytics
sonia@bluepeak.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing — phased billing plan?

Hi Sonia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Lauren (billing ops) and Dylan (accounts receivable) so we can propose an ops-friendly schedule.

Quick answers up front:
- We can do a hybrid approach: one upfront invoice for 40% (initial deposit), then 12 monthly drawdown invoices (charged against the deposit) with a final reconciliation invoice at year-end for true-up.
- For VAT: we typically include line-level VAT per country; for EU customers we can support reverse-charge lines if you provide VAT IDs and confirm B2B treatment.
- PO: we can consume your PO number on every invoice and include PO reference in the invoice header.

I've attached a working spreadsheet: 20270719-bluepeak-invoice-draft.xlsx (tabbed: Schedule / GL-mapping / Wire-instructions). Lauren/Dylan — please review the proposed timing and wire cutoffs and suggest any changes.

Next steps: Lauren to propose exact invoice numbers and month-by-month amounts; Dylan to confirm bank cutoffs/earliest debit dates.

Best,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@bluepeak.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing — phased billing plan?

Hi Sonia — thanks, this is straightforward to support. Added specifics below and attached a printable matrix (4-quarter-invoice-matrix.pdf).

Proposed billing pattern (option A - recommended):
- Invoice A (initial deposit): 40% of committed annual spend, issued upon signing.
- Monthly drawdown invoices (12): issued on the 1st of each month; each invoice reduces the deposit balance until depleted.
- End-of-year reconciliation: single invoice for usage true-up or credit depending on usage.

Invoice numbering convention:
- RDW-BP-2027-A (deposit)
- RDW-BP-2027-M01..M12 (monthly drawdowns)
- RDW-BP-2027-F (final reconciliation)

VAT handling by jurisdiction:
- US customers: no VAT, show tax as N/A.
- UK/EU: if you provide VAT ID(s) we will apply reverse-charge (B2B) and include VAT ID on every invoice line. If reverse-charge unavailable, we will apply local VAT rates per line.

Bank and timing notes:
- Wire cutoff for same-day credit to our ledger: 3:00 PM PT (weekday).
- For EUR payments via EUR account: allow 2 business days.
- We can support escrow routing if required (we'll provide bank details once escrow decision is confirmed).

Attachments: 4-quarter-invoice-matrix.pdf (visual schedule), reference GL mapping, sample invoice header with PO placement.

HubSpot deal: BP-DEAL-4827 — we'll push invoice records to the deal after issuance.

Dylan — can you confirm the escrow option and the expected clearing windows?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@bluepeak.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:05:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing — phased billing plan?

Thanks Lauren — this works for us. A couple of small items:
- Procurement requires the PO number on each invoice. I've attached the PO (BluePeak_PO_9987.pdf).
- We need to ensure invoices exclude any local withholding tax. BluePeak will not accept withholding deductions; please confirm gross amounts.
- For refunds/credits after reconciliation, can you issue a credit memo referencing the original invoice numbers? Procurement prefers a single credit memo rather than multiple small ones.

If you can send the final schedule and DocuSign link for the order form we will push this through our SSO procurement approval.

Appreciate the fast turnaround,
Sonia

Regards,
